samples.name: item-wood
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single game sprite for Desertod, a cozy medieval Slavic river village game. Attached tiny-town.png and tiny-farm.png are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their extremely simple chunky pixel clusters, warm restrained colors and top-down three-quarter view showing top and south-facing front; not isometric. Flat colors, 2-3 shades per material, top-left light, dark local-color edges, no pure black outline. Genuine transparent background. No text, labels, watermark, scene, ground, shadow, gradients, antialiasing, noise, detailed illustration or tiny decorative details. Single centered subject. 16x16 logical pixel canvas enlarged exactly 64x to 1024x1024. Every logical pixel is one uniform 64x64 square aligned to the grid. One logical pixel transparent margin. Three short chopped logs stacked in a small pyramid, light end grain rings visible on front, brown bark. Use very few large pixel clusters like the reference resource icons.
